goal: Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE: use the select tool to select 'MAIN-001 - Main Office' in the Branch dropdown, type operator ID 'super1', type password 'password', click Sign On. Click 'Place Account Hold'. Type member number '100234' into the search value field, click Search, click 'Select'. On the Place Account Hold form, the required field labels are prefixed with an asterisk, e.g. '* Share', '* Reason Code' -- use those exact label texts (without the trailing colon) as the 'name' argument. Use the select tool to choose OPEN-status share '100234-MMKT-15' (check the option list to confirm it says OPEN nowhere but trust this exact share ID -- select the option whose text starts with '100234-MMKT-15') as '* Share'. Use the select tool to choose 'LEGAL - Legal / levy' as '* Reason Code'. Type 'capability discovery run' into 'Notes'. Click 'Continue' to reach the confirmation review screen (heading 'CONFIRM ACCOUNT HOLD'). Then click 'Apply Hold' to actually place the hold for real (this is sandbox data, completing it for real is fine and required). After the hold is applied, extract the confirmation text or number visible on the resulting page (look for a heading or a 'Confirmation:' style label) as an output named hold_confirmation. If there is no separate confirmation value and the page just shows a success heading, extract that heading text instead as hold_confirmation. Then immediately call done referencing that output -- do not take any extra steps first.
final_summary: Signed on as super1 at MAIN-001 branch, navigated to Place Account Hold, searched member 100234, selected the account, chose share 100234-MMKT-15 (Money Market), reason code LEGAL - Legal / levy, added notes 'capability discovery run', continued to confirmation screen, and applied the hold. Confirmation number CN480444 was extracted from the resulting 'ACCOUNT HOLD APPLIED' page.
